config_name: Yoga 7a 2-in-1 16" — Ryzen AI 5 430 (Krackan Point), 16GB LPDDR5x, 512GB SSD, 16" touch

battery.notes: ~70Wh; Zen 5c efficiency good but 16" WUXGA panel; est. 9-12h light use. 4.53★/55 BBY listing broadly happy with runtime.

offers.name: Lenovo Yoga 7a 16" Touchscreen 2-in-1 Laptop - AMD Ryzen AI 5 430 - 16GB LPDDR5x - 512GB SSD - Windows 11 Home - Seashell

reviews.quote: The Yoga 7a 2-in-1 hits a sweet spot for those in the market for a big touchscreen OLED two-in-one. Where it stumbles is graphics horsepower.
The Yoga 7a 2-in-1 16 checks a fair bit of the right boxes.

professional.notes: Line-level scores from the Yoga 7a 2-in-1 16 review round (aggregated by Notebookcheck); no review of this exact config as of 2026-11.

praises: Cheapest 16" Copilot+ convertible at Best Buy — BBY reviewers call it a steal for big-screen casual work
Ryzen AI 5 430 (~50 TOPS NPU) is Copilot+ certified at entry pricing
Quiet and cool in everyday use; 4.53★ average from 55 owners
Solid aluminium convertible build at a fraction of Yoga 9i money
Good keyboard and fast fingerprint reader for the price
complaints: Radeon 840M is the weakest iGPU in this line — gaming limited to light/older titles
WUXGA (1200p) panel is dimmer and lower-res than the Intel siblings' 2K/OLED options
Heavier 16" chassis (~1.85 kg) is clumsy in tablet mode

design_philosophy: The AMD value flank of the Yoga convertible family: Zen 5c Krackan Point silicon brings Copilot+ NPU credentials to the biggest screen in the line at the lowest price. It trades GPU punch and panel quality for cost — the budget big-screen flip, not the performance one.
rating_notes: Ratings anchored on this SKU's own BBY aggregate (4.53★/55) + SHARED-yoga7i-2in1.md line calibration; no pro score found (bot-walls disclosed). Ryzen AI 5 430: Radeon 840M gaming 3.0, ~50 TOPS NPU → ai_ml 5.5. WUXGA IPS (sibling-name verified) → screen_quality 6.0. 16" deltas applied per calibration (screen_size +1.5, portability −1.5). CNET quote refers to the OLED variant of this line; this config ships with the IPS panel.
